# Convention de Commits - Serein Open Source

## Format

```
<type>(<scope>): <subject>

<body>

<footer>
```

## Types

- `feat`: Nouvelle fonctionnalité
- `fix`: Correction de bug
- `docs`: Documentation
- `style`: Formatage
- `refactor`: Refactoring
- `perf`: Performance
- `test`: Tests
- `chore`: Maintenance
- `build`: Build
- `ci`: CI/CD

## Exemples

```
feat(auth): add password reset
fix(user): resolve profile update bug
docs: update API documentation
```

Voir [GIT-WORKFLOW.md](GIT-WORKFLOW.md) pour plus de détails.
